title: Service Allowance for a Signing Delay, Paystride Visa Payroll Card Premier and Elite
content:
A signed lost or stolen card claim on the Paystride Visa Payroll Card Premier or Elite plan earns a service allowance. The allowance follows the business days from the claim's notice date to the signing day. Business days are Monday through Friday excluding Federal Reserve holidays, counted from the day after the earlier date through the later one.

| Business days from notice date to signing day | Service allowance |
|---|---|
| more than 8 | 10.00 |
| more than 5, up to 8 | 5.00 |
| 5 or fewer | nothing |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical counts)

| Count | Allowance |
|---|---|
| 5 | nothing |
| 6 | 5.00 |
| 8 | 5.00 |
| 9 | 10.00 |
| 10 | 10.00 |

*Counting example (hypothetical, no holiday):* for a notice on a Wednesday, signing on the Wednesday a week later is 5 business days and earns nothing. Signing on the Thursday after that is 6 business days and earns 5.00.
